scope: Research-only supplemental manual source review for six blocked Sumo career-result histories

cases.name: Kotoeiho
cases.officialAbsentNotice: Absent from Day 3 of November 2026 tournament
cases.conclusion: Official published six absences and independent SumoDB six do not equal cached native five. The source difference is real and has current-basho timing context; do not silently align or certify until period-specific reconciliation is audited.

cases.name: Shirokuma
cases.officialAbsentNotice: Absent from Day 1 of November 2026 tournament
cases.conclusion: The published JSA absence total differs from the saved API aggregate. Official absence notice confirms a tournament withdrawal, but by itself does not prove the precise cutoff or all-time absence reconciliation; certification stays blocked.

cases.name: Gojinyu
cases.conclusion: The independent JSA publication omits absence totals; an omitted aggregate is not proof of zero. A complete dated full-attendance proof or explicit independent absent total is still required.

cases.name: Ikawasakura
cases.conclusion: Current accessible SumoDB headline equals the saved native W-L-A, whereas earlier cached SumoDB crosscheck contains an extra win. Verify a fresh pinned source snapshot and the date-specific tournament ledger to resolve source drift before strict audit.

cases.name: Kototsubasa
cases.conclusion: Independent page headline, cached crosscheck and native aggregate are not contemporaneously aligned. Verify source snapshot chronology and all missing/extra tournament rows; no aggregate substitution.

cases.name: Tenshoyama
cases.conclusion: Independent JSA and SumoDB both show 173 kg, matching the preserved dated Sumo API measurement, while a distinct API profile field says 172 kg. This substantiates the conflict, not authority to overwrite profile or certify without an audited rule for as-of measurement provenance.
